notes: Authenticated as masenf through the GitHub app connector; the final listing contains 112 open PRs and all 80 non-drafts have fresh review/check state and local measurements.
Review and CI state came from the authenticated GitHub app connector and code-review checks; local git merge-tree supplied authoritative conflict status.
Git measurements and merge-tree use main 759eb60b8a3846c9a6b411005ff20f38c225f32a; local merge-tree is authoritative for clean versus conflicting.

Waiting on maintainer requires a clean local merge, SUCCESS with at least 60 GitHub Actions checks, zero unresolved review threads, and newer author activity; PR creation is the baseline when no peer maintainer has interacted.
Every red or cancelled PR has a current log-derived finding; superseded cancelled jobs with successful same-head replacements are not treated as substantive failures.
The label audit covered all 113 open PRs, drafts included; documentation requires real docs paths, while breaking labels require a current public-contract change.
audit_corrections: Recomputed peer-maintainer interaction from event roles; collector mismatches corrected: none.
Recomputed strict waiting membership from local merge, Actions depth, threads, and activity order; collector mismatches corrected: none.
#7614’s cancelled changelog job was superseded by a successful same-head run and does not block its strict waiting status.
#7624’s failures were traced to missing pydantic during test collection, but its eight unresolved substantive threads keep it author-owned regardless.
#7627 opened during collection and closed unmerged during final reconciliation; it is retained only in the label audit history, while #7628 remains on the board.

The adversarial audit promoted #7570 and #7547, corrected one-fix ownership for workflow gates and stale threads, normalized bot identities for the human-review count, added approval membership, and restored the review_ci_layer schema enum.
caveats: Latest commit or timeline activity is used as the push-time proxy because the connector does not expose a separate pushed timestamp.
Workflow-gated fork PRs show only reviewer-bot checks; they are not classified as green until the full Actions suite runs.
Automated review threads are counted as open issues when unresolved, but bots never count as maintainer interaction.
